<function name="ExitVehicle" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Forces the player to exit the vehicle if they're in one.

This function will bypass <page>GM:CanExitVehicle</page>. See also <page>GM:PlayerLeaveVehicle</page>
</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Makes player 1 leave their vehicle if they're in one.</description>
	<code>Entity( 1 ):ExitVehicle()</code>
	<output>Player 1 will exit the the vehicle that they're currently in.</output>

</example>
